comment: Sample data for the faceted-search demo. Shaped like an Edge Delivery Services query index or spreadsheet export, which is { data: [...] } with flat string fields.

data.title: Anatomy of a block
data.description: How a block receives authored content, and why decorating defensively matters when authors add and omit cells.

data.title: Widgets versus blocks
data.description: Blocks give form to authored content. Widgets are application parts an author references with a link.

data.title: Keeping it 100
data.description: Why the performance budget is a design constraint rather than a report you read after launch.

data.title: Accessible forms
data.description: Error summaries, focus management, and why unstyleable browser validation bubbles are usually the wrong default.

data.title: Formatting for other locales
data.description: Delegating numbers, currencies and dates to Intl instead of shipping a table of separators.

data.title: URLs as state
data.description: Keeping filters in the query string so a filtered view can be linked, shared and restored.

data.title: Progressive enhancement
data.description: Declaring behaviour in markup first, so a failed script degrades instead of erasing the page.

data.title: Live regions, politely
data.description: When to use polite over assertive, and why a slider should not interrupt on every value.

data.title: Café culture
data.description: A row with an accent in the title, so the search can prove it matches without one.
